narrative.overview: The user-approved world combines warm paper, charcoal type, deep forest green, restrained antique brass and natural photography. The agency feels like a working editorial studio: bold and composed, with tangible sheets, photographic studies and real website content.
keyCharacteristics: Strong sans-serif headlines with occasional italic serif emphasis.
Warm ivory space, forest actions and restrained brass details.
Natural garden, pool and residential exterior photography.
Layered editorial studies with useful, accessible interaction.

rules.name: The Photo Foreground Rule
rules.body: Headings over photographic concepts use the white photo-text token explicitly, with a dark image overlay. Agency-wide charcoal heading defaults must not override them.

dos: Do preserve warm ivory, charcoal, forest and restrained brass as the approved agency palette.
Do keep photographic text explicitly white and verify the actual CSS cascade.
Do build website studies as real content with working routes and native controls.
Do label fictional concepts clearly and preserve preview form disabling and noindex.
donts: Don't restore the rejected glass-art or abstract-ring identity.
Don't ship the approved concept screenshot as the whole website.
Don't let wheel gestures trap page scrolling or hide focused content.
Don't apply agency-specific appearance rules to independent client templates.
